title: Cyber cat rooftop chase

language_ideas.en: A cyber cat chases a glowing drone across a rainy Shanghai rooftop at night.
language_ideas.zh: 一只赛博猫在雨夜上海屋顶追逐发光无人机。

shot.title: Rooftop chase
shot.description: A cybernetic cat sprints across a wet high-rise rooftop while a glowing quadcopter drone escapes ahead through visible rain, with a recognizable Shanghai landmark skyline behind them, including Oriental Pearl Tower or Lujiazui tower silhouettes.
shot.camera: low side-tracking camera following the cat and drone in the same direction
shot.motion: cat leans forward mid-run, drone flies two meters ahead, rain streaks and neon reflections move past them
shot.music: tense electronic pulse with rain ambience

spatial_relationships: cat and drone appear in the same shot
drone stays ahead of the cat
rooftop edge and Shanghai landmark skyline anchor the location
motion_contracts: cat is visibly chasing, not posing
negative_constraints: no generic animal without cybernetic details
no generic city skyline without Shanghai landmark cues
success_criteria: cyber cat appears in at least half of sampled frames
glowing drone appears in at least half of sampled frames
rain or wet reflections appear in most sampled frames
Shanghai location is supported by recognizable Oriental Pearl Tower, Shanghai Tower, or Lujiazui skyline cues
